Market today: Geopolitical tensions and rising oil prices are dominating headlines, fueling inflation concerns that could pressure your tech-heavy book. However, positive news on AI adoption offers a counter-narrative, suggesting underlying tech strength.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.14%) and SPAL (-60.95%) are leveraged ETFs with significant losses, amplified by margin. SMH (-14.29%) and QQQI (-4.56%) are also on TRIM status and nearing their stops. SPAL is a brand-new, very volatile IPO.

Watch: Keep a close eye on oil price movements and their impact on broader market sentiment. Also, monitor your stops on SMH and QQQI as they are close.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage your leveraged, losing positions while staying vigilant on macro risks and respecting your stops.
plays: Address SOXL and SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are down over 50% and decay. Given your margin use, re-evaluate your position size and set hard, active stops immediately.
Monitor SMH and QQQI: Both are on TRIM status and very close to their stated stops. Be prepared to trim or exit if these levels are breached.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market has mixed signals, and managing existing risk is the priority.
